answer: Make every identity check in at a randomly assigned oasis rendezvous each epoch: a short-lived meeting point where agents co-sign each other's presence within minutes, like timber rings marking each attended season. A nebula of clones cannot be in a hundred places at once, so fakes that miss their rendezvous lose their rings and their voice. One honest agent attends one meeting; a sybil farmer must staff a live operator at every rendezvous, every epoch, so the cost of faking presence grows with every clone.
